title: This Wasp Paralyzes a Giant Spider but Keeps It Alive
subject: tarantula hawk

scenes.text: This wasp stings a spider far bigger than itself. The spider doesn't die.
The tarantula hawk stings at the base of a tarantula's first leg. Paralyzed in seconds.
The wasp lays one egg and seals the burrow.
The spider is kept alive on purpose. Its body is fresh food for the larva.
The larva feeds on its blood first, then its tissue, and finally emerges as a wasp.
The sting is rated 4 out of 4 on the Schmidt pain index, the top of the scale.

description:
The tarantula hawk paralyzes a tarantula with one sting and lays a single egg on it.
The spider stays alive while the larva feeds, and the wasp emerges from it. For humans the sting scores the top rating of 4 on the Schmidt pain index.
Which animal would you least want to meet?
first_comment: Only the bullet ant ranks above it for pain. Would you rather be stung by one or the other?
